name: Mythic+: client data at login
contract: At login the server sends what the client needs for Mythic+ and the Classic Heroics and Mythics without an addon: the Lua string for the Mythic difficulty, the champion count per dungeon, and the affix rows with Tiny swapped out for the week (fixed to 39 with .mythic week, then a relog). Every login also sends an empty +1 row for this week and the next, since MythicAffixes.dbc starts at +2 and the client would otherwise show the week's full set on a +1 key; week 40, which swaps nothing, gets exactly those two rows.

steps.label: The Mythic difficulty string (SMSG_PATCH_GLOBAL_STRINGS; PvE Power and Fel Commutation send theirs too)
and it carries the Mythic difficulty name
A champion count for every timed dungeon (SMSG_PATCH_TIMED_DUNGEON)
Week 39: affix rows with Tiny swapped out (SMSG_PATCH_MYTHIC_AFFIXES)
Week 40 swaps no affix but reorders them by tier: 248 rows each for weeks 40 and 41 plus their empty +1 rows (SMSG_PATCH_MYTHIC_AFFIXES)
